B1_VIX_ONLY.definition: v>=35 STRESS_VOL; >=25 ADVERSE_VOL; >=20 WATCH_VOL; otherwise CALM_VOL. A volatility namespace, not a claim of broad equity leadership.
B1_VIX_ONLY.paired_namespace: Coarse RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for B1-B3; native C03 for B4-B5

coarse_agreement.mapping: BROAD/SELECTIVE -> RISK_ON; CALM/WATCH/ADVERSE/STRESS_VOL mapped to RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for description only

B1_VIX_ONLY.information_tradeoff: Stable volatility labels omit equity breadth, leadership, fragility and futures curve. Cannot express broad versus selective structure.

B2_VIX_BREADTH.definition: Same absolute VIX thresholds; stress immediate; adverse VIX or WATCH plus adverse participation => DEFENSIVE; benign VIX plus favorable participation => RISK_ON; otherwise TRANSITION. Coarse namespace cannot identify broad/selective leadership.
B2_VIX_BREADTH.paired_namespace: Coarse RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for B1-B3; native C03 for B4-B5

coarse_agreement.mapping: BROAD/SELECTIVE -> RISK_ON; CALM/WATCH/ADVERSE/STRESS_VOL mapped to RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for description only

B2_VIX_BREADTH.complexity: VIX plus 11 sector series; 3 VIX and 2 breadth thresholds
B2_VIX_BREADTH.information_tradeoff: Coarse equity/volatility reference; omits leadership, fragility, curve and momentum.

B3_FAMILY_VOTE.definition: Two frozen lineage descriptors only. B STRESS overrides immediately; both ADVERSE => DEFENSIVE; both FAVORABLE => RISK_ON; mixed/opposed => TRANSITION. No cardinal sum.
B3_FAMILY_VOTE.paired_namespace: Coarse RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for B1-B3; native C03 for B4-B5

coarse_agreement.mapping: BROAD/SELECTIVE -> RISK_ON; CALM/WATCH/ADVERSE/STRESS_VOL mapped to RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for description only

B3_FAMILY_VOTE.complexity: All canonical data and pillar thresholds plus 4-rule family adjudication
B3_FAMILY_VOTE.information_tradeoff: Simpler final adjudication does not reduce data/feature maintenance; loses broad/selective distinction.

B4_PREVIOUS.definition: Prior canonical state only at immediately adjacent eligible session; first row or previous incomplete -> unavailable.
B4_PREVIOUS.paired_namespace: Coarse RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for B1-B3; native C03 for B4-B5

coarse_agreement.mapping: BROAD/SELECTIVE -> RISK_ON; CALM/WATCH/ADVERSE/STRESS_VOL mapped to RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for description only

B4_PREVIOUS.complexity: Canonical engine plus one state of memory; no threshold
B4_PREVIOUS.information_tradeoff: One-session lag retains all acquisition costs and delays new stress. Same-state persistence is not free correctness.
B4_PREVIOUS.threshold_sensitivity: B5 see threshold-sensitivity.json; B4 inherits previous-day C03 sensitivity and no own threshold.

B5_C03.definition: Actual accepted public production API outputs; verify against frozen P8 and Sweeper result per row.
B5_C03.paired_namespace: Coarse RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for B1-B3; native C03 for B4-B5

coarse_agreement.mapping: BROAD/SELECTIVE -> RISK_ON; CALM/WATCH/ADVERSE/STRESS_VOL mapped to RISK_ON/TRANSITION/DEFENSIVE/STRESS for description only

B5_C03.complexity: Frozen 2 lineage units, 4 subpillars, 13 thresholds and 7 precedence rules
B5_C03.information_tradeoff: Explicit equity structure and stress conjunction; no evidence that lower turnover alone is better.
B5_C03.threshold_sensitivity: B5 see threshold-sensitivity.json; B4 inherits previous-day C03 sensitivity and no own threshold.

risk_context_caveat: All listed risk context is contemporaneous/trailing and largely derived from classifier inputs. It describes semantics, not out-of-sample discrimination.

missing_robustness.evidence: challengers.test.mjs: explicit missing/undefined/nonfinite and calendar-gap witnesses; no missing rows occur in the1930 eligible core baseline.
missing_robustness.B0: Only actual archived observations; no interpolation.
missing_robustness.B1: Requires current finite VIX only; valid volatility namespace may exist while C03 is incomplete.
missing_robustness.B2: Requires VIX and admissible participation before any stress override.
missing_robustness.B3: Requires both named lineage descriptors before STRESS override. Immediate means no temporal confirmation after input eligibility; not bypass of missing core evidence.
missing_robustness.B4: No prior fill at first row, absent prior regime or non-adjacent session.
missing_robustness.B5: Unchanged public input contract and110 Sweeper adversarial checks.

conclusion: B1 is smoother but supplies volatility only. B2 and B3 discard equity leadership/breadth distinctions; B3 retains all source maintenance. B4 simply delays481 canonical changes, including18 stress entries. None establishes preservation of the complete descriptive contract at lower cost. V1 cannot be ranked on missing historical evidence. Keep C03; do not claim statistically proven superiority.
